name: RL10A-3-3A silver throat insert profile
source: Binder, M., Tomsik, T., and Veres, J. P., 'RL10A-3-3A Rocket Engine Modeling Project', NASA TM-107318, 1997, p. 55 (NTRS 19970010379).

coordinate_system.x: axial position relative to the throat; positive downstream
coordinate_system.r: radius measured from the engine centerline

conversion: Source coordinates digitized in inches and multiplied by exactly 0.0254 m/in; the physical throat point is normalized to x = 0 m and r = 0.062776 m.
notes: The inner and outer curves share their first and last points.
The normalized inner-curve throat radius is the physical silver-insert throat used by the RL10_2 simulation.

inner.description: Hot-gas-facing surface following the combustion-chamber and nozzle contour.

outer.description: Tube-facing surface following the shape of the cooling tubes.
